summary: Iteration 6 — Daily auto-send schedule (APScheduler) + WhatsApp via whatsapp-web.js Node service. Backend: 18/18 new tests in test_iter6_schedule_whatsapp.py PASS; full suite 92/93 (1 pre-existing inventory low_stock failure unrelated). Frontend: discovered & FIXED a critical TDZ bug — SettingsPage.js useEffect on line 109 referenced fetchScheduleStatus/fetchTimezones/fetchWaStatus which were declared with useCallback later in the file (lines 223/230/262), causing 'Cannot access fetchScheduleStatus before initialization' ReferenceError that broke the ENTIRE Settings page (including pre-existing Email tab). After moving the useEffect to after all useCallback declarations, all UI flows verified end-to-end: Schedule tab (time/tz/type/toggles/save/run-now with toast), WhatsApp tab (status card, QR modal renders data:image/png;base64 URL from node service, recipients add+persist+remove across reload, send-test correctly disabled when not connected, invalid phone shows toast). WhatsApp node service confirmed RUNNING under supervisor, generating QR; sends fail at isRegisteredUser as expected (no real phone scanned).

minor.issue: Invalid daily_report_time '99:99' or daily_report_timezone 'Foo/Bar' is persisted verbatim and only the reschedule throws (logged as ERROR). Spec is OK with 200 to avoid breaking the API, but a server-side validator (HH:MM 0-23/0-59 + zoneinfo lookup) would reject bad data at write-time and surface a clearer 422 to the UI.

Returns 503 when node says 'WhatsApp not connected' (good), but if node is reachable and isRegisteredUser times out, surfaces 500 with raw error string. Acceptable for dev preview; consider mapping this to 503/400 with friendlier detail.
When ALL sends fail returns 502 with detail={'message','failed'} as a dict (FastAPI normally serialises detail as string). Frontend must read detail.message — works but slightly unusual.

ui_bugs.issue: [FIXED in this iter] TDZ ReferenceError: useEffect referenced fetchScheduleStatus / fetchTimezones / fetchWaStatus before their useCallback declarations. Moved useEffect block to immediately after fetchWaStatus useCallback. Without this fix the entire SettingsPage crashes on mount.

issues: Status card uses red 'Not connected' pill; works but a yellow 'Initializing...' state is not visually surfaced even though /status returns initializing=true while puppeteer boots. Minor UX polish.

rca of the issue: TDZ Bug RCA — JavaScript `const` declared via useCallback is in temporal dead zone until its declaration line executes. SettingsPage's useEffect at line 109 had a dependency array [fetchUsers, fetchSettings, fetchScheduleStatus, fetchTimezones, fetchWaStatus] where the last 3 were declared at lines 223/230/262. Even though useEffect's callback runs after render, React evaluates the dependency array eagerly on the very line it's reached, hence ReferenceError on first mount. Reproduction: open /settings as admin → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay covers the page. Mitigation: physically moved the bootstrap useEffect to after all useCallback hooks. Long-term: enforce 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' eslint + position useEffects at component bottom or extract to custom hook.
